visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a brightly lit kitchen studio with a man, a woman, and a young child wearing aprons. They are gathered around a counter, interacting with dough. The child wears a colorful mask and a white long-sleeved shirt under a blue apron with a cartoon character. (2) The scene shifts to a close-up of the child's hands carefully cutting orange blocks of food on a blue cutting board, with the mother's hand assisting nearby. (3) The man appears in a mirror reflection, holding a smartphone to record himself; he is wearing a black tank top and a smartwatch. A picture of a famous chef is overlaid on the screen. (4) Close-up shots focus on the child's feet, showing him standing on tiptoe on a wooden floor, and then stepping onto a small wooden stool. The background is a clean, modern home interior. (5) The child is shown mixing eggs in a white bowl with a whisk, looking intently at his task. (6) The video transitions to a series of product shots for a wooden learning tower. The tower is shown in a neutral-toned living room with a cat and a rocking horse in the background. (7) The man demonstrates the folding mechanism of the wooden tower, showing how it can be easily collapsed with one hand in a spacious living room. (8) The child uses the fully extended tower to reach the kitchen sink and wash his hands. The kitchen features white cabinets and modern appliances. (9) The man is then seen using the tower as a step stool to reach a high cabinet in the kitchen. (10) The tower is converted into a blackboard; the child is seen writing numbers on it while a brown tabby cat sits on top of the frame. (11) Final shots show the tower being used as a display board outside a shop and inside a home, highlighting its versatility in different lighting conditions.
